costs.intro: A BMW X4 M Competition engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW X4 M engine rebuild starts from £5,500, whether your car is the standard X4 M or the X4 M Competition. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
